doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Upward Revision of Full-Year Business Performance Forecast and Modification (Increase) of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
doc_title_jp: 通期業績予想の上方修正及び配当予想の修正(増配)に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 通期営業利益予想の上方修正、エレクトロニクス分野向けフイルムおよび半導体ウエハー搬送用部材の堅調な推移

summary_en: Full-year dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised to 60 yen per share from 50 yen, reflecting upward revision of operating profit guidance and strong performance in electronics and semiconductor materials segments.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の1株当たり配当を60円に修正。営業利益予想の上方修正と電子材料・半導体関連事業の好調を踏まえた増配。

doc_title_en: Notice regarding Policy on Reduction of Strategic Shareholdings
doc_title_jp: 政策保有株式の縮減方針に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本効率性向上、持続的成長、中長期的な企業価値向上

summary_en: Achilles to reduce strategic shareholdings to below 20% of consolidated net assets by end of FY3/28. Proceeds to be allocated to business investment and shareholder returns. Board approved policy on 7 August 2026; company will conduct dialogue with investee companies and prioritize relationship preservation during unwinding.
summary_jp: アキレス、FY3/28までに政策保有株式を連結純資産比20%未満に縮減。売却益は事業投資と株主還元に充当。2026年8月7日取締役会決議。事業関係維持重視で段階的に実施。
tag_en: Cross-holdings reduction - policy to achieve <20% of consolidated net assets by FY3/28
tag_jp: 政策保有株式縮減／FY3/28までに連結純資産比20%未満を目標

doc_title_en: Notification regarding upward revision of full-year performance guidance and dividend forecast revision (dividend increase) for fiscal year ending March 2027
doc_title_jp: 通期業績予想の上方修正及び配当予想の修正(増配)に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 特別利益による当期純利益上方修正、中期経営計画の配当政策実現

summary_en: Year-end dividend raised to ¥50/share from ¥30/share for FY3/27, increasing annual total to ¥50/share. Payout ratio 31.1% of revised net income forecast (¥2,200M, up ¥900M from prior guidance due to securities sale gains). Aligns with medium-term plan target of ¥50/share minimum and 30%+ payout ratio.
summary_jp: FY3/27期末配当を30円から50円に引き上げ、年間50円に。配当性向31.1%。投資有価証券売却による特別利益計上に伴う当期純利益上方修正を反映。中期経営計画の50円/株目標および30%以上配当性向方針に沿う。
